summary: Every plain-text golden family isolates its SOP rule with discriminating hand-checkable cases, and the comparator follows the stated tolerance and exact-field rules. No accepted-wrong or rejected-valid path was found in the readable material. The two gzip golden families (generated.jsonl.gz, 24 batches; capacity.jsonl.gz, 1 batch) are graded but could not be decoded with the available read-only tools, so the review is incomplete for them.

unread_or_truncated_ranges: tests/expected/generated.jsonl.gz (whole file; gzip binary, the read-only tool refused it as binary and no decompression tool was available; ROSTER says 24 rows, graded by test_generated_batches at tests/test_outputs.py:194-195)
tests/expected/capacity.jsonl.gz (whole file; gzip binary, same limitation; ROSTER says 1 row, graded by test_capacity_batch at tests/test_outputs.py:198-202)

checks_performed: Read the instruction, the full SOP, all shipped package modules, the driver, both Dockerfiles, test.sh and test_outputs.py completely

Confirmed tests/shipped/tools/metalquant_run.py and environment/app/tools/metalquant_run.py share SHA-256 2b8b03b2... in packet-manifest.json, and that the verifier runs its own /opt/driver copy linked to /app/src (tests/Dockerfile:6-12, tests/test_outputs.py:25,98), so it grades the current package source rather than a stale or candidate-edited driver

Checked the comparator against instruction.md:7. Exact type and value on id/analyte/flag/ccv_ok/pass and on null value; rel 1e-6 for |e|>=1, else abs 1e-6 (test_outputs.py:103-126). blank_levels is compared as a key set, so key order is free (SOP 8.1). Lists are compared positionally, which the stated list order requires. Bools are rejected as numbers, and NaN fails the bound

Hand-recomputed every expected report in the 15 plain-text families from the SOP (lines resp=100+10c, 20+4c, 64+16c, 8+2c) and found no golden that contradicts the SOP or the instruction's 'keep shipped calculation where the SOP gives no rule' clause

For each SOP rule, identified a golden entry whose value changes under the shipped or another plausible wrong implementation. Examples: origin-forced fit, W-11 16.5 vs 12; first blank only, blank_mean level 3.5 vs 2; ND blanks in the mean, blank_nondetects; blank subtracted after dilution, W-72 68 vs 50; flag on amount, W-81/W-82/W-84; J inclusive at loq, W-92; unrounded or exclusive CCV limits, CCV-2/3/5; nearest-before-only bracketing, W-111; any-failed-CCV bracketing, W-113; dilution in spike denominator for results, W-131S 50 vs 100; J parent treated as non-result, W-134S 50 vs 200; shipped amount for ND parent, W-143S 42.5 vs 52.5, B-SPK As 43.75 vs 47.5; clamping negatives, W-102/W-103; list sorted by id instead of run order, report_order Z-9/B-SPK/C-1; cross-analyte ccv_ok, report_order As vs Tl

Checked exact-limit fixtures for floating-point fragility. The fixture lines have exactly representable slope and intercept, and the at-limit corrected readings (1.0, 5.0, 2.0) are exact under the common OLS formulations (centered sums, n*Sxy-SxSy, statistics.linear_regression-style) and under response-space blank subtraction. Near-limit cases sit 5e-8 away. The no-tie guarantee in SOP section 1 is honored by the CCV recoveries (110.04, 110.06, 89.96, 89.94)
Checked domain conformance of the plain-text fixtures against SOP section 1 (CCV true >= 10*loq, reading within 0.5-1.5x, 3-8 standards, dilution 1-1000, is_counts >= 1000, spike parent earlier)

Checked candidate-execution conditions for false rejection. The run uses setpriv as nobody with -I -S and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE, and /app is made world-readable by test.sh:16. A stdlib implementation in /app/src is reachable via the driver's sys.path insert. Site-packages are not, which matches instruction.md:3 ('against your /app/src') and an environment with no third-party libraries
Attempted to read both .gz goldens; the tool rejected them as binary

coverage_sweep.category: Map each required behavior to an assertion that fails if missing or reversed
coverage_sweep.reason: Each SOP section (2 calibration, 3 readings/results, 4 blank level, 5 corrected reading/amount/flags, 6 CCV recovery/pass/bracketing, 7 spike recovery, 8 report shape/order) has a dedicated family with at least one entry whose expected value differs from the shipped code and from the plausible wrong variant listed in checks_performed.

coverage_sweep.category: Check the full core result (values, membership, uniqueness, required outputs)
coverage_sweep.reason: compare() checks exact top-level key set, blank_levels key set and every value, list lengths, per-entry key sets and every field of every entry.

coverage_sweep.category: Named domain rule has an isolating case (not only held-out variation)
coverage_sweep.reason: Named rules: fitted intercept, mean of results anywhere, ND blanks excluded, single result, no-result fallback, blank before dilution, flags on corrected reading, exact mdl/loq, no clamping, rounded inclusive CCV limits, nearest-both-sides bracketing, unbracketed fallback, spike recovery of results, ND spike fallback, ordering. Each has an isolating plain-text fixture.

The shipped package fails at least calibration, blank_mean, dilution, flag_basis, flag_limits, ccv_limits, ccv_bracketing and spike_recovery. Partial fixes (listed in checks_performed) each fail at least one named entry.

coverage_sweep.category: Contract-valid alternatives for formatting, ordering and implementation choices are accepted
coverage_sweep.reason: JSON is parsed, not byte-compared. blank_levels key order is free. Numbers use the stated tolerance, and int or float are both accepted. Exact-limit fixtures are exact under common OLS formulations. The CCV rounding method is immaterial given the honored no-tie margin. The -S/-I execution restricts only to /app/src, which the instruction names.

coverage_sweep.category: Documented restrictions and lifecycle behavior enforced
coverage_sweep.reason: The byte-identical driver requirement is enforced by test_driver_is_unchanged. The 'no added correction/guard' restriction is reflected in goldens containing negative readings, negative blank levels and negative spike recoveries. There is no lifecycle or recovery promise.

coverage_sweep.category: Initialization-to-first-event transition of the CCV bracketing state machine
coverage_sweep.reason: Runs before the first CCV (W-121, W-128 before a failing CCV-25), between CCVs, after the last passing CCV (W-123), after the last failing CCV (W-125) and with no CCVs (ccv_unbracketed batch 3) are all graded.

coverage_sweep.category: Signed derived quantities: legal sign partitions discriminated
coverage_sweep.reason: Spike recovery is graded both positive and negative (-150, -16.04, -15). The blank level is graded both negative (-1.0) and positive. Readings below nought are graded for samples, and the corrected reading goes negative (ND) and positive.

coverage_sweep.category: Proxy behavior, Oracle-specific representation, stale binaries, self-controlled comparisons
coverage_sweep.reason: Expected reports are sealed files pinned by ROSTER hashes and are not produced by candidate code. The verifier executes its own driver copy against the live /app/src. No representation beyond the SOP report (native JSON types) is required.
Every plain-text fixture is within the SOP section 1 domain and instruction.md:7 scope. The ccv_limits batch without samples and the no-blank batches are allowed by the stated ranges.

coverage_sweep.category: Correctness of held-out generated and capacity goldens (false-rejection risk)
coverage_sweep.reason: generated.jsonl.gz (24 batches) and capacity.jsonl.gz (1 batch) are graded in full but could not be decoded. Their expected values, domain conformance, and any exact-limit or near-tie cases could not be inspected.

rules: SOP 3 ND definition (no rule when a result is needed)
interaction_sweep.case_or_path: Parent ND with spike result (W-141S, W-143S, B-SPK As/Cd), spike ND with parent result (W-142S), both ND (W-141T), J parent as result (W-132S, W-134S). The expected values use the shipped formula with SOP amounts only in the ND cases.

rules: SOP 3 blank judged on reading vs mdl
SOP 4 mean of blank results / no-result fallback
interaction_sweep.case_or_path: Blank at exactly mdl counted (MB-10). Blank 5e-8 below mdl excluded (MB-37). All-ND blanks use the first blank's reading (-1.0, 0.25, 0.5 with the blank after the sample). No blanks gives 0.0.
The amount crosses mdl/loq while the corrected reading does not (W-81 amount 5 ND, W-82 amount 12 J, W-84 amount 50 ND, W-91 amount 10 J).
In a 4-analyte batch, analytes have mixed pass results at one CCV, and a sample after the last CCV inherits the per-analyte pass (C-1 Tl false, As true).

rules: SOP 6 unbracketed fallback uses the SOP-defined pass
interaction_sweep.case_or_path: No plain-text fixture places a sample after a CCV whose recovery lies in the band where the rounded-inclusive and shipped-exclusive rules disagree. A candidate using the old ccv_passes only for the unbracketed fallback is implausible, since pass is computed once per CCV. Any such case would be in the unread generated set.

unresolved_checks.concern: The generated and capacity goldens could contain an expected value that a contract-valid implementation cannot reproduce. Examples: an out-of-domain batch, a floating-point-fragile exact-limit flag, or a golden inconsistent with the SOP. Any of these would reject valid work. Conversely, they may be the only coverage for some interactions.
unresolved_checks.missing_evidence: Decompressed contents of tests/expected/generated.jsonl.gz and tests/expected/capacity.jsonl.gz, or a reviewer tool able to read gzip. With them, the 25 batches can be recomputed against SOP TM-07 and checked for section 1 domain conformance and at-limit fragility.

uncertainty: No defect was found in the readable verifier, comparator or 15 plain-text golden families. The axis cannot be cleared because 25 graded batches in two gzip files could not be inspected with the available read-only tools.
